notes.title: Update 0.30 - Visuals and small fixes
notes.content:
Hi guys, happy new year!

Apologies for the long long wait for this one. 

Three things!

1. [b]Season 2 will be ending tomorrow evening (15/01/2018) at 7PM GMT.[/b] I know it's dragged on for a long time (far longer than intended), so there will be more in the way of rewards to make up for it, with more than just skins this time.

2. This patch is the first big overhaul of the visuals and should (I hope) be immediately noticeable. There is more in the way of optimisation as well as a full rework of the lighting and rendering. There are a bunch of small fixes also included in this update, too many to mention!

3. This week will see two more updates, one bringing a much needed tutorial for newer players, and the other a brand new map.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mZ3tx2l.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eQ5yb7J.jpg[/img]



Hope you like it and sorry for the wait.

Craig

notes.title: Update 0.26 - The AI Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

Quick update today that brings a much more aggressive, fluid AI to play against.

FIXED: AI shooting through certain walls. (Note, there still might be an issue with weapons coming through walls - work in progress.)
FIXED: Backup AI moving slowly towards you without ever really reacting or taking cover.
FIXED: AI now raise the alarm after a set amount of seconds in combat.
NEW: A more aggressive AI that will work together to take you down. This AI will communicate amongst themselves in an effort to take you down.
NEW: Added text overlays for timelock buttons and the vault computers to better explain things.

Hope you like it! Please remember this is a work in progress, there may be issues with the new system and it may seem a little unbalanced at first - it's all open to fixes and balance changes.

CK

notes.title: Season 1 Results & Update 0.21
notes.content:
Hi everyone! So we're at the end of the first season and I thought I'd do a little run-through of the outcome, highs and lows and all that. A note beforehand though, this is the first season of Break_In and as such, it was never going to be the smoothest ride! The time was pushed back on the final day due to unforeseen circumstances, and I hope this didn't inconvenience anyone too much. 

So, here is how we're going to do this!

[b]The top prize - some shiny new golden weapon skins (what else? :D)[/b] is going to be shared amongst the [b]three players with the most money in the bank as of this moment and the 3 players who have stolen the most throughout the season in total.[/b] That means six of you guys will receive the golden weapon skins very shortly!

[b]The second prize - some slightly less shiny, but still pretty shiny silver weapon skins[/b] will go to those finishing in the top 50 of the most wanted table at this moment. 

[b]The "taking part" prize of some Halloween weapon skins[/b] will go to everyone who took part this season.

We'll adjust this going forward of course! Onto the awards then.

[h1]The Break_In Season 1 Awards[/h1]

[b]The hardened criminal award for most cash stolen in total, throughout the course of this season goes to...[/b]
[olist]
[*]Dall ($5,456,294)
[*]Xlis1 ($4,426,847)
[*]Velth ($3,095,664)
[/olist]
Congrats guys, you got the gold!

[b]The "I thought I'd be the only winner?!" award for most cash in the bank goes to...[/b]
[olist]
[*]sumsar99 ($174,952)
[*]Xlis1 ($159,444)
[*]majoradvil ($134,686)
[/olist]
Congrats to you guys too, you've also got the gold!

[b]The award for the top 3 most generous donors (total lost on failed raids) goes to...[/b]
[olist]
[*]majoradvil (-$371,060)
[*]Silverfusion (-$236,563)
[*]Velth (-$201,325)
[/olist]
Very generous!

[b]The "Lord Fury" award for the single biggest failed raid goes to...[/b]

Silverfusion (-$47,792)

[b]The award for single biggest take of the season goes to...[/b]

Dall ($200,000+)

[b]The best safehouse award (for the most cash made from player failures) goes to...[/b]

majoradvil ($408,536)

[h1]Update 0.21[/h1]

That's all for this season then! I hope you guys enjoyed it, season 2 will kick off at some time in the next few days. The rewards for season 2 will be safehouse cosmetics!

- NEW: Skins feature.
- FIXED: Some AI issues.
- FIXED: Some non-exciting stuff.

Craig

notes.title: Update 0.17 - Season 1
notes.content:
Hi guys, big update this time! Several new things added, several things to discuss, and several things to consider!

Let's start with the big one.

[h1]Season 1[/h1]

Break_In will now be played out over seasons, each lasting one month. [b]Everyone[/b] who participates during these seasons will unlock something cosmetic for the following season, with the top 50 players (the most wanted) taking something a little bit more special and exclusive. It goes without saying that the number 1 player will also get something special! I haven't yet decided on what form these rewards might take, but it will definitely be something cosmetic. Perhaps something for your safehouse, a flashy getaway car, even weapon skins? I'm very open to ideas on this, and what you'd like to see!

You can access the [b]Most Wanted[/b] list from the main menu. It's probably a good place to find a big score too!

A side note, everyone's map has been reset to the Junkyard, and their money defaulted to $50,000. In the interest of fairness, of course :)

[h1]Return of Apartments[/h1]

I was never quite happy with how the Apartments map turned out before, but it's now back in and fully converted to the grid system, featuring a massive 139 spaces to place defenses. There are also a couple of new types of defense exclusive to this map, the laser grid and the lockdown door. These defenses can be placed in any corridor space, with the lasers triggering the alarm on player contact, and the lockdown door slamming down when the alarm sounds for 60 seconds, closing your invader's escape route.

[h1]Other fixes[/h1]

As always, more bugs fixed. 

- Hitboxes now accurate for backup.
- Garage door on Junkyard should now open and close for AI.
- AI can no longer see through certain vault doors.
- Fixed a camera placement on Hideout.
- Removed muzzle flash from the silenced pistol.
- Fixed alarmed windows button, you can now purchase these.
- Some other small issues.

The update should be live in 5-10 minutes all being well, I hope you guys enjoy it. Have a great weekend!

Craig

notes.title: Update 0.15
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Update 0.15 is almost live and will kick off a week of content for Break_In culminating in an announcement on Friday evening! A quick run through of the features.

[b]Grid[/b]

The way you place defenses on your safehouse is now customisable, you can pick what you want to put in which space. This should add a lot to the game going forward!

Note that as of tonight only Junkyard is using the grid, with the Hideout and Apartment maps to follow this week. Forest will be withdrawn for a while until I can improve it and give it some substance.

[b]AI[/b]

The AI has been completely rewritten and are now a lot smarter. They'll no longer rush you on arrival, instead searching the place to find you and call to their allies for help. They'll also try and flank you in combat, and advance on you from cover.

[b]UI[/b]

The first steps have been taken towards a better UI, though this is only a first iteration with a lot more to come. 

Lastly, sorry for the delay. It's been far too long but things are back on track at long last. Thank you to those of you who stuck with the game, and I hope this update improves your experience as dramatically as I think it will!

Craig

notes.title: Update 0.07a
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Update about to go live. Featured this time:

- Electronic panel hacking. Don't want to wait around for 2 minutes each time on a door countdown? Try finding the override panel (they can be in different places in each map) and breaking the little puzzle and all doors will come open instantly! Be careful though, you get a limited amount of moves, and failing will trigger an alarm. Once you move one piece you are committed, and backing out at this stage will also trigger an alarm.

Wouldn't want it to be too easy would we? :)

- Safe cracking. No more hit and running on people with money printers. If you have a money printer now, your cash will be kept in a safe which will require cracking. There's a detailed explanation when you try it in game and I hope you'll enjoy it!

- A new piece of music for the most recent map. Oz works his magic again.

- A few fixes around the place, a lot still to make though. Wanted to get this out there as I know a few of you found the waiting around a bit dull, so hopefully this livens things up :)

Achievements to follow next week, and a new map or two for next month.

Have a great weekend, I'll be in the group chat for a little while if anyone has questions or anything.

Thanks!

Craig

- Safe cracking. No more hit and running on people with money printers. If you have a money printer now, your cash will be kept in a safe which will require cracking. There's a detailed explanation when you try it in game and I hope you'll enjoy it!

- A new piece of music for the most recent map. Oz works his magic again.

- A few fixes around the place, a lot still to make though. Wanted to get this out there as I know a few of you found the waiting around a bit dull, so hopefully this livens things up :)

Achievements to follow next week, and a new map or two for next month.

Have a great weekend, I'll be in the group chat for a little while if anyone has questions or anything.

Thanks!

Craig

notes.title: Break_In Development Roadmap & Summer Sale
notes.content:
[h1]Break_In Development Roadmap[/h1]

Hello all, things have been a little quiet for the past week as I had some time off with family. Back in action now however :)

Thank you so much for your feedback and support for Break_In; for a small developer trying to make a great gaming experience this means a lot. Based on the feedback and suggestions received on our Facebook page and the Steam Forums I have created this roadmap, showing you guys the update schedule for the coming months.

The purpose of this road map is to provide a guideline for each update, and obviously things can go wrong - so delays (especially for the larger features) could occur. Of course I will try to keep you informed of these before they occur and to keep to the schedule as much as possible.

On that note from July onwards I shall begin a monthly release schedule with major updates occurring every month. Also, just because only so many features are listed for each update doesn’t mean you can’t expect bonus features to come out based on community activities and suggestions.

Thanks again for your support and happy gaming! 

ck0101 

[b][u]July - Surgical Heisting[/u][/b]

Integration of “mini-games” into heists, safe cracking as a means of earning money, electronic door locks that require hacking to break into, and potentially something nastier than landmines. 

Also the implementation of Steam Trading Cards and the first volume of Achievements based on community feedback. 

[b][u]August - Arsenal of the Thief[/u][/b]

A new map, two to three new player weapons for the run and gun thief, and additional equipment for the more technical thief. 

Also, players who have had their accounts warned of hacking have until this update to improve their behavior as the anti-cheat system will be implemented. This system shall be monitored by myself and my moderators to confirm its effectiveness and to gauge the community’s response. Please do provide as much feedback as possible.

[b][u]September - Criminal Penthouse[/u][/b]

2 more maps to be released with designs suggested by the community. Also a rework of the way the intruder log works so that now you will receive more details about what actually happened while you were being robbed so you can plan your defences as necessary which will be more important in the next update. 

A new paramilitary force, FIEND, will be the backup you will dread dealing with - and you WILL know when they have arrived. Shout out to community member CrAzEeFiEnD and thank you for all your support - really appreciate it and I hope that you like this update!

[b][u]October - Home Making[/u][/b]

The biggest community request has by far been more customisation options and of course why should your evil lair/castle/penthouse/garbage pit be the same as every other one? This whole update shall be dedicated to implementing the grid based customisation system for traps/patrols/cameras into your bases. 

This update will be a big one and was originally going to be scheduled for much later but community interest in this one seems high, so let’s do it. This update will ensure that every base will be different defence-wise, and that the same plan won’t work for all intrusions.

As a result this will be the first part of this systems integration into the game but please don’t expect it to be finished immediately - this will be something I have to work on throughout development especially as the community provides suggestions on what to add!

[b][u]November & December - Criminal Community Ideas[/u][/b]

Continuing with the community focus and getting a head start on the Christmas spirit these two updates are being set aside for community suggestions. 

Expect 2 new maps for each update along with new weapons and gear for the player to utilise. 

Of course a massive bug sweep and optimisation shall be occurring right throughout this period as I attempt to get Break_In ready for 2016.

[b][u]2016 - Criminal Networking[/u][/b]

Based on the requested features from the community a new roadmap shall be drawn up for the New Year & following beta period. In this period we’ll work out how and when to integrate co-operative raiding, factions, a lot more new maps/weapons/gadgets and more. 

Thank you all for your support and feedback so far and please do join our Facebook and forum communities to provide more feedback and remain up to date with all the updates and developer discussions!

Break_In Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/breakinthegame]https://www.facebook.com/breakinthegame[/url]
Break_In Forums: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/357320/discussions/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/357320/discussions/[/url]

[h1]Summer Sale[/h1]

As you may have noticed, Break_In has a 25% discount for the duration of the summer sale to bring some new players on-board and give you all a bunch of new targets to steal from :)

Tell your friends, family, anyone who you think may be interested!




[i]Interested in streaming or creating videos of break in?

If you would like access to developer support and early notifications and access to upcoming updates please contact Lord Fury through steam: http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198019818357/[/i]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.03A
notes.content:
Almost live... 5-10 minutes or so!

Changelog:

- New backup system

So, before there was an infinite supply of backup charging at you until you died. Now you're able to pick from one of currently two (soon to be four) security providers who will sell you additional guards. The amount you buy will be the amount that shows up when people try to attack you, in waves. The two security providers have slight differences in weapons, health, aggressiveness and response time. And one is cheaper than the other :)

- Fixed an issue where you could jump out of the map on Junkyard, again.
- Added a 1hr cooldown when targetting the same player again after a successful raid.
- Wiped the database, fresh start for everyone (sorry, was required!)
- Set [url=www.twitch.tv/camjob97]Camjob[/url] as the default target for new players.
- Fixed an issue blocking the purchase of the money printer on the Forest map.
- A few small fixes here and there.

There will be another update on Friday fixing bugs, balancing equipment/weapon/defense costs, and adding a new weapon or two. Hope you like the new system, it's going to need a lot of tweaking, but hey that's why we're here right? :)

ck
